lines.say: In Einstein's theory of gravity, a wormhole is a tunnel through space with two openings, called mouths.
lines.en: In Einstein's theory of gravity, a wormhole is a tunnel through space with two openings, called mouths.
lines.ja: アインシュタインの重力の理論では、ワームホールは、二つの出入り口を持つ空間のトンネルです。出入り口を「口」と呼びます。

lines.say: A signal can go from one mouth to the other in two ways: through the tunnel, called the throat, or through ordinary space outside.
lines.en: A signal can go from one mouth to the other in two ways: through the tunnel, called the throat, or through ordinary space outside.
lines.ja: 信号は、一方の口からもう一方へ、二つの道で行けます。トンネルの中、つまり「のど」を通る道と、外のふつうの空間を通る道です。

lines.say: For a signal to pass, something must hold the throat open. In the model of this video, quantum fields hold it open.
lines.en: For a signal to pass, something must hold the throat open. In the model of this video, quantum fields hold it open.
lines.ja: 信号が通るには、何かがのどを開いたままにしなければなりません。この動画のモデルでは、量子の場がのどを開いています。

lines.say: For three decades, physicists have argued about one question: do quantum fields stop such a wormhole from becoming a time machine?
lines.en: For three decades, physicists have argued about one question: do quantum fields stop such a wormhole from becoming a time machine?
lines.ja: 物理学者たちは 30 年にわたり、一つの問いを論じてきました。量子の場は、こうしたワームホールがタイムマシンになるのを止めるのか。

lines.say: A twenty twenty-six paper takes one model of such a wormhole, pushes the clocks of its two mouths apart, and asks what the fields do.
lines.en: A 2026 paper takes one model of such a wormhole, pushes the clocks of its two mouths apart, and asks what the fields do.
lines.ja: 2026 年のある論文は、こうしたワームホールのモデルを一つ取り、二つの口の時計をずらして、場が何をするかを問いました。

lines.say: The paper does not say whether time travel is possible. Everything in this video is about one model.
lines.en: The paper does not say whether time travel is possible. Everything in this video is about one model.
lines.ja: 論文は、時間旅行ができるかどうかを述べていません。この動画の話は、全て一つのモデルについてのものです。

scenes.title: Two clocks and two margins
scenes.title_ja: 二つの時計と、二つのゆとり

lines.say: Each mouth has its own clock. Suppose that mouth one sits deeper in a well of gravity than mouth two.
lines.en: Each mouth has its own clock. Suppose that mouth 1 sits deeper in a well of gravity than mouth 2.
lines.ja: それぞれの口には、自分の時計があります。口 1 が、口 2 よりも重力の井戸の深い所にあるとします。

lines.say: Then the clock of mouth one runs slower. The paper calls this difference the drive, delta.
lines.en: Then the clock of mouth 1 runs slower. The paper calls this difference the drive, δ.
lines.ja: すると、口 1 の時計は遅れて進みます。論文は、この違いを「駆動」と呼び、δ で表します。

lines.say: The clock of mouth one runs at e to the minus delta times the rate of mouth two. With delta equal to one, that is about zero point three seven.
lines.en: The clock of mouth 1 runs at e^−δ times the rate of mouth 2. With δ = 1, that is about 0.37.
lines.ja: 口 1 の時計は、口 2 の e^−δ 倍の速さで進みます。δ = 1 なら、約 0.37 倍です。

lines.say: So a time shift builds up between the two clocks. If nothing pushed back, it would keep growing at a steady rate.
lines.en: So a time shift builds up between the two clocks. If nothing pushed back, it would keep growing at a steady rate.
lines.ja: そのため、二つの時計の間に、時間のずれがたまっていきます。押し返すものが何も無ければ、ずれは一定の速さで増え続けます。

lines.say: In this model, the throat is long. Light takes more time through the throat than through the outside.
lines.en: In this model, the throat is long. Light takes more time through the throat than through the outside.
lines.ja: このモデルでは、のどは長いのです。光は、外を通るよりも、のどを通る方が時間がかかります。

lines.say: The paper watches two margins. Margin A: how much later light arrives through the throat than through the outside, as the clocks of the mouths measure it.
lines.en: The paper watches two margins. Margin A: how much later light arrives through the throat than through the outside, as the clocks of the mouths measure it.
lines.ja: 論文は、二つのゆとりを見張ります。ゆとり A は、口の時計で測って、のどを通った光が、外を通った光よりどれだけ遅れて着くかです。

lines.say: Margin B: how long light takes to go once around, through the throat and back outside. A time shift makes this loop shorter in one direction.
lines.en: Margin B: how long light takes to go once around, through the throat and back outside. A time shift makes this loop shorter in one direction.
lines.ja: ゆとり B は、光がのどを通って外を戻り、ひと回りするのにかかる時間です。時間のずれは、一方の向きのひと回りを短くします。

lines.say: If A falls to zero, or B goes to zero, a path of light could close on itself. The paper calls this the model's threshold for closed null curves.
lines.en: If A falls to zero, or B goes to zero, a path of light could close on itself. The paper calls this the model's threshold for closed null curves.
lines.ja: A がゼロまで下がるか、B がゼロに近づくと、光の道が自分自身に閉じうるのです。論文は、これをモデルの「閉じた光的曲線のしきい」と呼びます。

lines.say: The paper uses a wormhole that Maldacena, Milekhin and Popov described in twenty eighteen.
lines.en: The paper uses a wormhole that Maldacena, Milekhin and Popov described in 2018.
lines.ja: 論文は、Maldacena・Milekhin・Popov が 2018 年に示したワームホールを使います。

lines.say: Two black holes with opposite magnetic charges sit at a distance d. The regions near them join into one throat.
lines.en: Two black holes with opposite magnetic charges sit at a distance d. The regions near them join into one throat.
lines.ja: 逆向きの磁荷を持つ二つのブラックホールが、距離 d を置いて並びます。その近くの領域がつながって、一つののどになります。

lines.say: Charged particles called fermions move along the magnetic field lines. The lines form loops, through the throat and back outside.
lines.en: Charged particles called fermions move along the magnetic field lines. The lines form loops, through the throat and back outside.
lines.ja: フェルミオンと呼ぶ電荷を持つ粒子が、磁力線に沿って動きます。磁力線は、のどを通って外を戻る輪になっています。

lines.say: In a closed loop, quantum fields carry a small negative energy, called Casimir energy. Here, this energy holds the throat open.
lines.en: In a closed loop, quantum fields carry a small negative energy, called Casimir energy. Here, this energy holds the throat open.
lines.ja: 閉じた輪の中では、量子の場が小さな負のエネルギーを持ちます。これをカシミールエネルギーと呼びます。ここでは、このエネルギーがのどを開いています。

lines.say: So the fields that hold the wormhole open are the same fields that feel a time shift between the mouths.
lines.en: So the fields that hold the wormhole open are the same fields that feel a time shift between the mouths.
lines.ja: つまり、ワームホールを開いている場は、口の間の時間のずれを感じる場と同じなのです。

lines.say: The paper describes the throat with a simple two-dimensional theory of gravity, at linear order. It uses two models of the loop, called R one and R two.
lines.en: The paper describes the throat with a simple two-dimensional theory of gravity, at linear order. It uses two models of the loop, called R1 and R2.
lines.ja: 論文は、のどを、2 次元の簡単な重力の理論で、1 次の近似で表します。輪のモデルは二つで、R1 と R2 と呼びます。

lines.say: The paper does not model how the drive is produced. The drive is switched on smoothly, and in some runs it is switched off again.
lines.en: The paper does not model how the drive is produced. The drive is switched on smoothly, and in some runs it is switched off again.
lines.ja: 駆動がどう生まれるかは、論文はモデルにしていません。駆動はなめらかに入れ、いくつかの計算では、また切ります。

lines.say: First, the paper looks at a slow limit, in which the fields keep up with every change.
lines.en: First, the paper looks at a slow limit, in which the fields keep up with every change.
lines.ja: まず論文は、ゆっくりの極限を見ます。この極限では、場が全ての変化についていきます。

lines.say: With a time shift, fermions that go one way around the loop see a shorter loop. Those that go the other way see a longer loop.
lines.en: With a time shift, fermions that go one way around the loop see a shorter loop. Those that go the other way see a longer loop.
lines.ja: 時間のずれがあると、輪を一方の向きに回るフェルミオンには、輪が短く見えます。逆の向きに回るものには、長く見えます。

lines.say: Their Casimir energies are then different. The difference is a steady flow of energy through the throat.
lines.en: Their Casimir energies are then different. The difference is a steady flow of energy through the throat.
lines.ja: すると、両者のカシミールエネルギーが違ってきます。その差が、のどを通る、絶えないエネルギーの流れになります。

lines.say: This flow moves mass from one mouth to the other.
lines.en: This flow moves mass from one mouth to the other.
lines.ja: この流れが、一方の口からもう一方の口へ、質量を運びます。

lines.say: The change in mass changes the clock rates of the mouths, and this change works against the drive.
lines.en: The change in mass changes the clock rates of the mouths, and this change works against the drive.
lines.ja: 質量が変わると、口の時計の進み方が変わります。この変化は、駆動に逆らう向きにはたらきます。

lines.say: There is one point of balance. There, the clock ratio of the throat, e to the delta, cancels the drive exactly.
lines.en: There is one point of balance. There, the clock ratio of the throat, e^δ, cancels the drive exactly.
lines.ja: 釣り合いの点が一つあります。そこでは、のどの時計の比 e^δ が、駆動をちょうど打ち消します。

lines.say: But the system does not settle at this point. It swings around it, again and again.
lines.en: But the system does not settle at this point. It swings around it, again and again.
lines.ja: しかし、系はこの点に落ち着きません。点の周りを、何度も何度も揺れ動きます。

lines.say: Compare a ball that rolls in a bowl without friction. It passes the bottom, and it does not stop there.
lines.en: Compare a ball that rolls in a bowl without friction. It passes the bottom, and it does not stop there.
lines.ja: 摩擦の無いお椀の中を転がる玉と比べてみましょう。玉は底を通り過ぎ、そこで止まりません。

lines.say: The reason: the slow equations do not change when time runs backward. Near the point, they give a pure swing, with no growth and no decay.
lines.en: The reason: the slow equations do not change when time runs backward. Near the point, they give a pure swing, with no growth and no decay.
lines.ja: 理由は、ゆっくりの方程式が、時間を逆向きにしても変わらないことです。点の近くでは、育ちも衰えもしない、純粋な揺れになります。

lines.say: When the drive is switched off, the system keeps moving on a closed path. In general, it does not return to where it started.
lines.en: When the drive is switched off, the system keeps moving on a closed path. In general, it does not return to where it started.
lines.ja: 駆動を切っても、系は閉じた道の上を動き続けます。ふつうは、出発した所には戻りません。

lines.say: One caution: this limit needs slow changes, but the swing itself is not slow. The paper uses the limit only to find the mechanism.
lines.en: One caution: this limit needs slow changes, but the swing itself is not slow. The paper uses the limit only to find the mechanism.
lines.ja: 一つ注意があります。この極限は、ゆっくりした変化を前提にしますが、揺れ自体はゆっくりではありません。論文は、この極限を、仕組みを見つけるためだけに使います。

scenes.title: With the travel time of light
scenes.title_ja: 光の通る時間を入れると

lines.say: Next, the paper adds the time that light needs to cross the loop.
lines.en: Next, the paper adds the time that light needs to cross the loop.
lines.ja: 次に論文は、光が輪を渡るのにかかる時間を入れます。

lines.say: A small disturbance can be split into modes. Each mode has a number called a root. If a root lies off the vertical line in this picture, its mode grows or dies away.
lines.en: A small disturbance can be split into modes. Each mode has a number called a root. If a root lies off the vertical line in this picture, its mode grows or dies away.
lines.ja: 小さな乱れは、いくつかのモードに分けられます。それぞれのモードには、根と呼ぶ数があります。根がこの図の縦の線から外れていれば、そのモードは育つか、消えていきます。

lines.say: In each of the twelve cases, the twenty-eight roots inside the counting region lie exactly on the line. Three of them come from the method itself.
lines.en: In each of the 12 cases, the 28 roots inside the counting region lie exactly on the line. Three of them come from the method itself.
lines.ja: 12 の場合のそれぞれで、数える範囲の中の 28 の根は、ちょうど線の上にあります。そのうち三つは、方法そのものから来るものです。

lines.say: Exact checks, including interval arithmetic, confirm this. So no counted mode decays or grows.
lines.en: Exact checks, including interval arithmetic, confirm this. So no counted mode decays or grows.
lines.ja: 区間演算を含む厳密な確かめが、これを裏づけます。数えたモードは、どれも衰えず、育ちもしません。

lines.say: After the drive stops, the slow swing turns into a root whose pattern matches a boost, a change of viewpoint inside the throat.
lines.en: After the drive stops, the slow swing turns into a root whose pattern matches a boost: a change of viewpoint inside the throat.
lines.ja: 駆動が止まった後、ゆっくりの揺れは、ある根につながります。その形は、ブースト、つまりのどの中での見方の変え方と一致します。

lines.say: In a related theory, such changes are not physical. The paper does not settle this, so it does not claim the slow swing as a physical mode.
lines.en: In a related theory, such changes are not physical. The paper does not settle this, so it does not claim the slow swing as a physical mode.
lines.ja: 関連する理論では、そうした変え方は物理的ではありません。論文はこの点を決着させていないので、ゆっくりの揺れを物理的なモードだとは主張しません。

lines.say: Then the full equations are run, for drives of zero point zero zero one, zero point zero one, and zero point one. That makes eighteen runs.
lines.en: Then the full equations are run, for drives of 0.001, 0.01 and 0.1. That makes 18 runs.
lines.ja: 次に、完全な方程式を、駆動 0.001、0.01、0.1 で解きます。合わせて 18 の計算です。

lines.say: For fifty swings after the drive is switched on, or off, both margins stay positive.
lines.en: For 50 swings after the drive is switched on, or off, both margins stay positive.
lines.ja: 駆動を入れた後、または切った後の 50 回の揺れの間、二つのゆとりはどちらも正のままです。

lines.say: The time shift reaches at most zero point four to zero point five times delta, while the drive is switched on or off. After the drive stops, a swing remains.
lines.en: The time shift reaches at most 0.4 to 0.5 times δ, while the drive is switched on or off. After the drive stops, a swing remains.
lines.ja: 時間のずれは、最大で δ の 0.4〜0.5 倍で、駆動を入れるときか切るときに達します。駆動が止まった後も、揺れが残ります。

lines.say: For the two smallest drives, this says little. Even with no push back, the shift would not reach the threshold in the same time, in all but one case.
lines.en: For the two smallest drives, this says little. Even with no push back, the shift would not reach the threshold in the same time, in all but one case.
lines.ja: いちばん小さい二つの駆動では、これはあまり多くを語りません。押し返しが無くても、一つの場合を除き、同じ時間ではずれはしきいに届かないからです。

lines.say: The paper then raises the drive to zero point two, zero point three, zero point six and one. That is forty-eight more runs.
lines.en: The paper then raises the drive to 0.2, 0.3, 0.6 and 1. That is 48 more runs.
lines.ja: 次に論文は、駆動を 0.2、0.3、0.6、1 に上げます。さらに 48 の計算です。

lines.say: In the windows fixed in advance, both margins stay positive. The smallest values are one point one six for A, and two point zero three for B.
lines.en: In the windows fixed in advance, both margins stay positive. The smallest values are 1.16 for A and 2.03 for B.
lines.ja: 前もって決めた区間の中で、二つのゆとりは正のままです。いちばん小さい値は、A が 1.16、B が 2.03 です。

lines.say: So, within these runs, the model does not reach its threshold for closed null curves.
lines.en: So, within these runs, the model does not reach its threshold for closed null curves.
lines.ja: つまり、これらの計算の中では、モデルは閉じた光的曲線のしきいに届きません。

lines.say: The largest time shift grows with the drive. At delta equal to one, it is zero point four two one.
lines.en: The largest time shift grows with the drive. At δ = 1, it is 0.421.
lines.ja: 時間のずれの最大は、駆動とともに大きくなります。δ = 1 では 0.421 です。

lines.say: Two runs stopped early, at a numerical limit of the time steps. The paper says nothing about them after that point.
lines.en: Two runs stopped early, at a numerical limit of the time steps. The paper says nothing about them after that point.
lines.ja: 二つの計算は、時間の刻みの数値の限界で、早めに止まりました。その点から後について、論文は何も述べていません。

scenes.title: Is the description still valid?
scenes.title_ja: 記述はまだ成り立つか

lines.say: A model like this is valid only while some ratios stay small. The paper sets two lines: zero point one or less holds, and one or more fails.
lines.en: A model like this is valid only while some ratios stay small. The paper sets two lines: 0.1 or less holds, and 1 or more fails.
lines.ja: こうしたモデルが成り立つのは、いくつかの比が小さいうちだけです。論文は二つの線を引きます。0.1 以下なら成り立ち、1 以上なら破れます。

lines.say: These lines are conventions, fixed before the computation. They are not physical thresholds.
lines.en: These lines are conventions, fixed before the computation. They are not physical thresholds.
lines.ja: この線は、計算の前に決めた約束事です。物理的なしきい値ではありません。

lines.say: At delta equal to one, one ratio, S eight, reaches one in five of six cases, before the margins fail. Taken alone, this would say that the description breaks down.
lines.en: At δ = 1, one ratio, S8, reaches 1 in five of six cases, before the margins fail. Taken alone, this would say that the description breaks down.
lines.ja: δ = 1 では、比の一つ S8 が、六つのうち五つの場合で、ゆとりが尽きる前に 1 に達します。これだけを見れば、記述が破れることになります。

lines.say: But S eight depends on how the points of the throat are labelled. A boost, a change of viewpoint, can change it.
lines.en: But S8 depends on how the points of the throat are labelled. A boost, a change of viewpoint, can change it.
lines.ja: しかし S8 は、のどの点にどう目盛りを付けるかによります。見方の変え方であるブーストで、値が変わりうるのです。

lines.say: So the paper builds new ratios from what each mouth measures with its own clock. A boost does not change them.
lines.en: So the paper builds new ratios from what each mouth measures with its own clock. A boost does not change them.
lines.ja: そこで論文は、それぞれの口が自分の時計で測る量から、新しい比を作ります。ブーストでは、これらは変わりません。

lines.say: With these ratios, the largest value at delta equal to one is zero point six six six. That is below one.
lines.en: With these ratios, the largest value at δ = 1 is 0.666. That is below 1.
lines.ja: これらの比では、δ = 1 での最大は 0.666 です。1 より小さい値です。

lines.say: With these ratios, a value of one comes only from two fixed ratios, S two and S three. They are set by the number of fermions and the coupling, before any drive.
lines.en: With these ratios, a value of 1 comes only from two fixed ratios, S2 and S3. They are set by the number of fermions and the coupling, before any drive.
lines.ja: これらの比を使うと、1 に達するのは、二つの固定した比 S2 と S3 だけです。これらは、駆動の前から、フェルミオンの数と結合の強さで決まっています。

lines.say: At the larger drives, most cases are undecided, inside the band from zero point one to one. No case reached the verdicts stops, or does not stop.
lines.en: At the larger drives, most cases are undecided, inside the band from 0.1 to 1. No case reached the verdicts “stops” or “does not stop”.
lines.ja: 大きな駆動では、ほとんどの場合が、0.1 から 1 の帯の中で未決です。「止まる」や「止まらない」の判定に届いた場合はありません。

scenes.title: What the paper does not claim
scenes.title_ja: 論文が主張しないこと

lines.say: The paper does not say whether time travel is possible, or whether the chronology protection conjecture holds.
lines.en: The paper does not say whether time travel is possible, or whether the chronology protection conjecture holds.
lines.ja: 論文は、時間旅行ができるかどうかも、時間順序保護予想が正しいかどうかも、述べていません。

lines.say: All its statements hold in one model, for the loops, drives and run windows that were computed.
lines.en: All its statements hold in one model, for the loops, drives and run windows that were computed.
lines.ja: 論文の言明は全て、一つのモデルの中で、計算した輪・駆動・計算の区間についてのものです。

lines.say: Some effects are not in the model, for example radiation from the mouths. They could take energy away from the swing. The lack of damping belongs to the closed model.
lines.en: Some effects are not in the model, for example radiation from the mouths. They could take energy away from the swing. The lack of damping belongs to the closed model.
lines.ja: モデルに入っていない効果があります。たとえば口からの放射です。それらは揺れからエネルギーを奪うかもしれません。揺れが衰えないのは、閉じたモデルの性質です。

lines.say: The lines zero point one and one are conventions. And the new ratios are one choice, not the only correct one.
lines.en: The lines 0.1 and 1 are conventions. And the new ratios are one choice, not the only correct one.
lines.ja: 0.1 と 1 の線は約束事です。そして新しい比は、一つの選び方であって、唯一の正しいものではありません。

lines.say: To read the paper, look up this D O I. The paper, the code and the records are on Zenodo.
lines.en: To read the paper, look up this DOI. The paper, the code and the records are on Zenodo.
lines.ja: 論文を読むには、この DOI を引いてください。論文・コード・記録は Zenodo にあります。

lines.say: This video was made with the help of AI. The voice is synthetic.
lines.en: This video was made with the help of AI. The voice is synthetic.
lines.ja: この動画は AI の助けを借りて作りました。声は合成音声です。
